scene_summary: A gray tabletop plate built from archival paper surfaces: a floating white plugin panel sits over a torn orange folder slab, surrounded by checker tile, cream ledgers, pink typed sheets, black photo well, mint scan paper, command-like ticks, and a signal-like orange form. The interface can be mapped through real visible edges, tears, holes, typed rows, scan borders, and paper seams.
usable_surfaces: floating white rounded plugin panel with pale controls and blue button
torn orange folder slab with punched holes and ragged bite
dusty pink typed sheet with compact black rows
mint-green scan paper field with grid and stamps
thin striped command-edge paper tick strip

detected_objects.label: central floating plugin panel
detected_objects.visual_evidence: large white rounded modal surface at center with visible header icons, stacked pale control wells, blue rounded button, and soft drop shadow occluding papers underneath

detected_objects.label: oversized orange folder slab
detected_objects.visual_evidence: wide manila-orange folder slab across lower center, with three punched black holes at left, vertical fold crease, worn edges, and a torn bite removed near the modal

detected_objects.label: upper-left checker tile
detected_objects.visual_evidence: small blue-and-cream checker paper fragment in the upper-left, with torn right notch and irregular bottom wear marks

detected_objects.label: top-row pale document frame
detected_objects.visual_evidence: large cream ledger spread at the top right, with black ruled table, central fold seam, punched/scan marks, typed blocks, and dark border-like paper edges

detected_objects.label: dusty pink typed sheet
detected_objects.visual_evidence: dusty pink rectangular typed slip near top center-right with compact black monospaced rows and hard clipped archival edges

detected_objects.label: black photo well
detected_objects.visual_evidence: black horizontal aperture directly beneath the pink slip, carrying pale typed marks and a dark photo-well surface

detected_objects.label: mint lower document wash
detected_objects.visual_evidence: mint-green scan paper field to the right of the modal, with grid/table lines, black stamped rows, fold seam, dark stain at top right, and worn cropped corners

detected_objects.label: prompt-edge command ticks
detected_objects.visual_evidence: narrow vertical cream strip with repeated blue command-like ticks/stripes at the upper-left row, functioning as a compact paper-edge mark rather than a broad card

detected_objects.label: Signal Panel
detected_objects.visual_evidence: large lower-right orange form panel with black command bars, table rules, barcode-like bottom ticks, and rounded worn paper corners

complexity_assessment.rationale: The plate remains legible as an expressionist archive-board collage, but many similarly sized documents compete around the central modal and orange folder; interaction mapping should privilege the hero panel, torn folder, and strongest paper apertures.
